         SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue

)

FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly mo
  ON mo.month = strftime('%Y-%m', date('2023-01-01', '+' || (m.n - 1) || ' months'))
ORDER BY m.n;

question: 哪些國家 2024 年的銷售額比 2023 年下滑？各下滑了多少百分比？
label: allow
sql_query:
SELECT
  "Country",
  ROUND(
    (
      SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2024' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2
  ) AS "Decline Percentage"
FROM sales_data
WHERE substr("Order Date", 1, 4) IN ('2023', '2024')
GROUP BY "Country"
HAVING
  SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END) > 0
  AND SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2024' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
    < SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY "Decline Percentage" DESC, "Country" ASC;

question: 2024 年比 2023 年營收掉的國家有哪些？掉了多少百分比？

sql_query:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT
    "Country",
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2023' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr("Order Date", 1, 4) = '2024' THEN "Total Revenue" ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE substr("Order Date", 1, 4) IN ('2023', '2024')
  GROUP BY "Country"
)
SELECT
  "Country",
  revenue_2023,
  revenue_2024,
  (revenue_2023 - revenue_2024) * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0) AS drop_percentage
FROM rev
WHERE revenue_2024 < revenue_2023
  AND revenue_2023 > 0
ORDER BY drop_percentage DESC, "Country" ASC;

question: Electronics 在 2024 年每一季與 2023 年同一季相比，銷售額成長率各是多少？
label: allow
sql_query:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT 1 AS q
  UNION ALL SELECT 2
  UNION ALL SELECT 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 4
),
rev AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    (CAST(substr("Order Date", 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter,
    SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE "Product Category" = 'Electronics'
    AND CAST(substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  'Q' || q.q AS "Quarter",
  COALESCE(r24.revenue, 0) AS "2024 Revenue",
  COALESCE(r23.revenue, 0) AS "2023 Revenue",
  (COALESCE(r24.revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r23.revenue, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(r23.revenue, 0), 0) AS "Growth Rate (%)"
FROM q
LEFT JOIN rev r24 ON r24.year = 2024 AND r24.quarter = q.q
LEFT JOIN rev r23 ON r23.year = 2023 AND r23.quarter = q.q
ORDER BY q.q;

question: 2023 到 2024 年間，哪一季的銷售額季增率最高？是多少？
label: allow
sql_query:
WITH quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(substr("Order Date", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    (CAST(substr("Order Date", 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter,
    SUM("Total Revenue") AS revenue
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE "Order Date" BETWEEN '2022-10-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  cur.year || '-Q' || cur.quarter AS quarter,
  (cur.revenue - prev.revenue) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0) AS qoq_growth_rate
FROM quarterly AS cur
LEFT JOIN quarterly AS prev
  ON prev.year = CASE WHEN cur.quarter = 1 THEN cur.year - 1 ELSE cur.year END
  AND prev.quarter = CASE WHEN cur.quarter = 1 THEN 4 ELSE cur.quarter - 1 END
WHERE cur.year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2024
ORDER BY qoq_growth_rate DESC, quarter ASC
LIMIT 1;

  FROM sales_data

  GROUP BY 1, 2

)
SELECT
